picks.excerpt: Figma demos its new Eraser tool and updated Fill tool on canvas, part of the post-Config wave of direct-manipulation drawing features.
picks.rationale: A shipped canvas tool from Figma itself — designers can use the Eraser and updated Fill in their files tomorrow.

picks.excerpt: Autodesk Flow Studio's new 3D Editor + Canvas combines interactive 3D scene construction with generative 2D video models, making AI filmmaking directable instead of prompt-and-pray.
picks.rationale: Turns generative video from prompt roulette into a directable 3D scene workflow — a concrete change to how visual work gets staged.

picks.excerpt: Marvelous Designer 2026.1 adds a Seamline Ripping Tool plus Brush Pinching and Pinching Simulation Override, giving garment and character artists far finer control over cloth.
picks.rationale: A named release with new hands-on cloth tools that garment and character artists can apply immediately.

picks.excerpt: A coding agent can write the markup and ship a page in seconds, but it can't see what it made. Design Diff proposes a visual feedback loop that hands agents a screenshot-level comparison against the intended design.
picks.rationale: A reusable technique for closing the design-to-agent gap: give the agent a visual diff against the intended design instead of trusting the markup.

picks.excerpt: Walmart is 3D printing store structures with Alquist and FGMI, a fabrication shift that pulls computational design and robotic construction into mainstream retail architecture.
picks.rationale: A named, at-scale case study of computational design and robotic fabrication moving from demo to mainstream retail construction.
